value.question: What does a sponsor have to report during a trial?
plan: Sponsors must report trial results to regulatory authorities.
They must disclose adverse events and safety data.
They are required to submit final study reports.

value.draft: Sponsors are required to report trial results to regulatory authorities, ensuring transparency and compliance. They must also disclose any adverse events and safety data encountered during the study. Additionally, sponsors are obligated to submit a final study report, which includes all relevant findings, methodology, and conclusions. These reports help regulatory bodies assess the safety and efficacy of the investigational product and make informed decisions regarding its approval or further use.
